name: SHOWTIME: STATIC
source:
You play as Static, a man who doesn't know where he came from and how long he has been in this self-colored world. You must find out the secret of why he is there.

[Edited from [url=https://loony-pendulum.itch.io/showtime-static]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你扮演Static，一个不知道自己从哪里来，也不知道自己在这个本色世界呆了多久的人。你必须找出他为何在那里的秘密。

[编辑自[url=https://loony-pendulum.itch.io/showtime-static]Itch.io[/url]]
